title: Lockheed VP Jim Ryder: the veil thinning as weakening magnetosphere

tellings.quote: this guy Jim Ryder, this VP of space systems there saying that the vent the fail sorry, the veil is thinning and that that is literally the magnetosphere of the earth which is weakening right now.

plain: Jim Ryder, a vice president of space systems at the aerospace company Lockheed Martin, is said to have claimed that the old spiritual idea of "the veil is thinning," the barrier between our world and other realms, refers literally to Earth's magnetosphere, which he says is weakening right now. An unnamed crew member on Michels's episode with Graham Hancock relays this as something Ryder said, which would mean a physical change in the planet is opening the way to other kinds of experience.
